en.name: Destiny Draw: Light My Way
en.effect:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Your normal draw this turn will be 1 Level 4 or lower "Rokket" monster or "Quick Launch" from your Deck.
2: Reveal 1 of the following cards in your hand: 1 Level 4 or lower "Rokket" monster, "Rapid Trigger", "Heavy Interlock", or "Double Interlock". Either place that card on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.
